name: MNGO
one_liner: MNGO provides software for Indian college placement cells to manage student drive applications, tracking, and recruiter updates in one central system.
what_you_sell: A campus placement platform that replaces spreadsheets and messaging groups with a dedicated management system for college placement cells, students, and recruiters.
who_buys_it: Training and Placement Officers (TPOs) and college administrators at higher education institutions in India.
_claims_to_check: Implies the platform is fully ready for a 30-minute live setup today, while the roadmap states the MVP is in build and pilots begin in Q3 2026.
Implies active company/recruiter workflows are live, but the roadmap schedules the company network and recruiter portal launch for late 2026/2027.
Claims full DPDP compliance and database-level isolation for college student data.
Claims exactly 5 founding partner college slots remain for the free pilot program.
